exposure: Implementation of an evidence-based oxytocin protocol for management of the third stage of labor
cohort: 14,603 pregnant patients delivering at a level III maternal care referral hospital over a 60-month period from January 2013 to December 2017
finding: A standardized oxytocin infusion protocol in the third stage of labor resulted in a significant decrease in PPH for both vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: A standardized oxytocin infusion protocol in the third stage of labor resulted in a significant decrease in PPH for both vaginal and cesarean deliveries.
